findings.summary: Fixture locks in wrong highlight: arch list incomplete/typo'd so common arches render as invalid.spec
Loose converted grammar instead of submodule, so upstream license is missing from --acknowledgements
Body doesn't say whether grammar is verbatim or hand-edited (Manual modifications entry)
No evidence the syntax meets the doc/assets.md popularity criterion (10,000 downloads); #2931 may have been declined on it
Source|Patch rule has no line-end pop and can swallow description paragraphs; redundant
Tag rules not anchored to line start
Fixture skips most of the grammar
Conditional keyword rule lacks word boundary and omits %elif
Lean: dedupe arch push bodies, drop obsolete norootforbuild rule

why: Finding 4 names the doc/assets.md popularity criterion and the missing evidence for it, which is the maintainer's reason. It ranks fourth behind grammar bugs and packaging.
